description.summary: place surfaces in the side canvas

protocol.description:
The side canvas is a column that slides in over the desktop from the right edge of an output. The compositor owns the column: where it sits, when it is shown and how it moves. Clients place surfaces in it as items.
Items are stacked top to bottom in the order they were created, each at the full width of the column. The compositor chooses the width and tells the client through configure; the client chooses the height through the size of the buffer it attaches.
The canvas is shown and hidden by the user. Clients are told when that happens so they can pause work nobody can see.

interface.name: otto_canvas_manager_v1
interface.description: The manager global lets a client put surfaces in the side canvas.

entry.name: role
entry.summary: the surface already has a role

request.name: get_canvas_item

description.summary: place a surface in the canvas

request.description:
Give the surface the canvas item role and add it at the bottom of the column.
It is a protocol error (role) to pass a surface that already has another role.
The compositor answers with a configure event. The client must acknowledge it before it attaches a buffer. A visibility event (shown or hidden) follows the first configure.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager object. Items already created are unaffected.

interface.name: otto_canvas_item_v1

description.summary: a surface in the side canvas

interface.description:
One surface in the column. The compositor positions it; the client draws it at the configured width and at whatever height it needs. Content taller than the space left in the column is clipped.
Destroying the item removes the surface from the canvas. The surface keeps its role and may only be given to a new canvas item.

event.name: configure
event.description:
The width, in logical points, the item is laid out at. It is the width of the canvas column, and changes when the user changes it.
The client acknowledges with ack_configure and draws its next buffer at this width. The height is the client's choice.

event.name: shown
event.description: The canvas is visible, or on its way in. The item receives frame callbacks and should draw current content.

event.name: hidden
event.description: The canvas is off screen. The item receives no frame callbacks until the next shown event, and may stop work that only feeds what it draws.

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: Acknowledge the configure event with the given serial.

request.name: dismiss
request.description: Ask the compositor to hide the canvas, for example after the user acted on something in the item. Ignored while the canvas is hidden.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Remove the surface from the canvas. The items below it move up.
